The main objective of this project is to develop a fingerprint authentication mechanism as a prerequisite for vehicle ignition along with the driving license verification of the user. The results obtained are far more reliable with this double verification than a single verification due to the biometrics as well as the government issued license being involved.

articleTitle: A Novel PID-FOPD Controller for LFC Including IPFC and RFB
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper deals with the three-area power system load frequency control (LFC), comprises of thermal generation including reheat turbines. A cascade proportional integral derivative (PID) and fractional order proportional derivative (FOPD) i.e. PID-FOPD controller is proposed and analysed for LFC mechanism. Here cascading and fractional order mechanism will increase the degree of freedom of the proposed controller. Furthermore, interline power flow controller (IPFC) in combination with redox flow battery (RFB) ensures more improvement in system stability. Here, integral square error (ISE) is considered as performance index (PI) and a meta-heuristic sine cosine algorithm (SCA) is executed to optimize the controller parameters. The simulation results with MATLAB/SIMULINK® toolbox illustrates the advantage of the proposed controller over classical controllers for small load perturbation (SLP) and random load perturbation (RLP) in three-area power system. Lastly, sensitivity is checked by varying system parameters, which demonstrates the robustness PID-FOPD controller.

articleTitle: Analyzing User Requirements and Interface Designing on Mobile Solutions for Waste Segregation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Segregation of our waste is essential as the amount of waste being generated today caused an immense problem. Many items in regular household waste is biodegradable and/or recyclable and in fact, only a very minor portion is actually meant to be disposed of. Owing to this we decided to formulate a plan for a mobile application named Segrify, that would help in assisting regular people; no matter their level of skill with technology; with the segregation of waste. It is strongly founded on the principles of human computer interface (HCI) to make interaction and UX as smooth as possible. Aside from having designs for an interesting flashcard based game for younger users, the design would incorporate the use of an AI chatbot assistant which, when spoken to, would classify the requested item into the correct criteria of waste. It would also include a community chat feature encouraging community participation and interaction as well as a feed section to deliver the latest news and updates to the users. Aside from having designs for an interesting flashcard based game for younger users, the design would incorporate the use of an AI chatbot assistant which, when spoken to, would classify the requested item into the correct criteria of waste. It would also include a community chat feature encouraging community participation and interaction as well as a feed section to deliver the latest news and updates to the users.

articleTitle: Separation of Multiple Stationary Sound Sources using convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a deep neural network-based approach for separating multiple sound sources located at different positions in-room environments. The Mixed signal is recorded using a Linear microphone array in-room environment. We have also shown that the known signals are correctly separated with the Convolutional Neural Network-based algorithm using mapping mixed-signals with the original signal. We have proposed a novel separation architecture and database creation algorithm with various combinations of gaussian noise source signals to create a diverse mixture for training and testing purposes. After the sound separation model's training and testing, it is shown that the system's performance is better compared with other sound separation models. It is beneficial to separate the multiple mixed signals in a known source case compared to an unknown source case.

articleTitle: Linearization of a Coupled tank MIMO system and its validation using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The coupled tank set-up is an important element used in process control industries with an objective of controlling levels of liquid in the tank. The interacting coupled tank level control system has been described in this paper is multivariable in nature. The dynamic model of such a system being non-linear requires linearization such that the conventional controllers such as PID controller can be designed. The linearization is carried out using a Taylor series expansion. The extracted linear model along with PI controller is further used to simulate the system performance in Matlab and the validation of the same is carried out through the experimentation on the physical set-up.

articleTitle: Development of Personal Identification Number Authorization Algorithm Using Real- Time Eye Tracking & Dynamic Keypad Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The digital financial transaction is on a continuous rise and going to be the order of the day. These transactions rely on the entry of the Personal Identification Number (PIN) by the user. The PIN is a common user authentication method for many applications such as ATM's, unlocking personal devices. Cyber-crimes are committed by shoulder surfing or thermal tracking. PIN entry is found vulnerable to password attacks such as shoulder surfing or thermal tracking. Intruders try to gain passwords or personal identification numbers (PIN) by glancing over the user's shoulder and observing the pattern of PIN entry (shoulder surfing). Thermal tracking is another method followed by cyber thieves, using the heat traces to decode the entered PIN by the user. This paper proposes a novel approach to authorization of PIN. To demonstrate the same, a web application is developed with trio-based authentications using machine learning techniques. Initially, the application detects and recognizes the user's face. A dynamic keypad is displayed which prompts the user to provide input PIN via eye blink. User's eye is detected and monitored by the application in order to capture the PIN and verifies the same with the existing PIN in the database. On a successful PIN verification process, the application allows the user to proceed with the transaction. The results show the proposed novel approach is better than existing approaches.

articleTitle: Single Image Blind Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the growth of technology and digital media, images have started playing a critical role not only in our day-to-day lives but also in fields like Biology and Astronomy to name a few. However, images prove to be useful only when they can successfully convey information to a viewer. Blurred images are lacking in this aspect and deblurring images to extract useful data from them is the need of the hour. Through this research, we have attempted to develop a generic solution to deblur images affected by uniform motion and focus blur. Apart from achieving the feat of being able to tackle multiple types of blur, our work has shown to be at par with its competitors in terms of the Peak Signal to Noise Ratio metric and the precision factor of the new and developing Object Detection metric.

articleTitle: Increasing Grid Power Transmission Using PV-STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Renewable energy resource plays an important role due to increasing energy claim. Power generation by PV technology is one of the fastest growing renewable energy sources due to its clean, economical and sustainable property. Grid integrated PV systems plays an important role in power generation sector. As the energy demand is increasing day by day, the power transfer capability of transmission line is increasing which leads various problems like stability, increase in fault current, congestion etc. To overcome the problem, we can use either FACTS device or battery storage or construct additional lines which is cost effective. This paper deals with grid connected PV system, which functions as PV-STATCOM. Voltage and damping control are used to elevate the power transfer capacity and to achieve regulated voltage within the limits at the point of common coupling (PCC). The studies are performed on SMIB and the simulation is carried out in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

Author Keywords: Single machine connected to infinite bus (SMIB)

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Average Current-Mode Controlled Bidirectional Multiphase DC-DC Converters used in Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, digital Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller is proposed for DC-DC converter which is employed for energy transfer between 12V battery and 48V battery. The bidirectional DC-DC converter offers energy transfer in both the directions, from 12V battery to 48V battery and vice versa. Multiphase topology of the DC-DC converter supports energy demand of high power(up to 3.3kW) loads, reduces ripples in output voltage thereby reducing filter capacitor value. It also reduces thermal degradation as current is divided in each phase, eventually improves the overall performance and efficiency of the converter. PID controller is used due to its simple implementation, fast computation and good quality of control. Digitalization of the PID controller offers improved response and re-programmability of the control strategy without significant hardware changes. The main function of the controller is to maintain regulated output voltage irrespective of load and input voltage variations. Proposed controller is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink environment in buck and boost mode for varying operating conditions and results are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Adding Flexibility to Surface-Acoustic-Wave Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a flexible technique for designing a wide range of SAW filters. The technique employs certain features of recently published window functions, enabling the designer to select a suitable window to obtain either minimum transition width or minimum sidelobe level, or an optimum combination of both. A comparison of three SAW filter designs is given, which reveals that there exists a trade-off between transition width, sidelobe level, and passband ripple.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis Of Different Topologies Of On-board Charger (OBC) With An Approach Of Interfacing It With MCB
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper involves the comparison of the various topologies of 6.6kW onboard charger (OBC) which are used in electric vehicles. Since, the circuitry part of an OBC is divided into 2-stages; power factor correction (PFC) stage and DC-DC converter stage. Here three topologies have been discussed for both PFC and DC-DC converter. Under PFC part; Conventional boost PFC, interleaved boost PFC, and semi bridgeless PFC are discussed, and Under DC-DC converter; full-bridge converter, phase shift full-bridge converter, and series resonant converter are discussed. The selection procedure for selecting best topology among them is related to efficiency calculation for both PFC and DC-DC converter circuit. After that, a future technology is suggested i.e making an OBC having active PFC topology, to be compliant with Master Control Board (MCB) using Renesas RH850 E2M microcontroller that allows an automated communication among an Electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE) and hardwares inside EV like OBC, DC-DC, Electronic control unit (ECU), Battery management system (BMS) etc using controller area network (CAN) communication protocols.

articleTitle: Adaptive Averaging Algorithm for Noise Cancellation in Musical Instruments Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The signal characteristics varies so fast that too of noise signal, for cancellation of noise and handling of it is very difficult. The FIR filter would not able to converge fast so that we get the desired output. In that case we have go for the other option, adaptive filters may be utilize because of their fast convergent rate. Least Mean Square (LMS), Normalized Least Mean Squares (NLMS) and Recursive Least Squares (RLS) algorithms frequently used. But these algorithms have problems of high computational complexity and stability, for that Averaging Algorithm is applied because of its fast convergence rate and low computation complexity. In the present work we are implementing Averaging Algorithm for noise reduction in the signals of the musical instruments. For that we have done experiments with Gaussian noise. The implementation is done on Matlab software.

Author Keywords: Normalized Least Mean Square and Recursive Least Square

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Modeling of Microstrip Patch Antennas: A Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper aims to elucidate a design procedure that can help solve both the synthesis and analysis parts of an electromagnetic microstrip patch antenna problem. Unlike numerical conventional modeling methods or maybe even analytical methods, artificial neural network are way faster and easier to perform due to their robust correlation and high accuracy. They are also computationally inexpensive when compared to tradition analytical and conventional methods alike. Due to their brevity and highly flexible nature, they are easy to train and work on and can be expanded or modelled in different ways as per the use case owing to their plasticity. Conventional methods are not only time consuming put also require high computational capacity unlike the neural network perspective which has been proposed here. Hence, this paper gives a brief overview of the same and also includes a brief background and basic working of artificial neural networks, activation functions, Radial Basis functions, etc. from both the analysis and synthesis perspective from a RF designers viewpoint. Unlike previous soft computing neural network approaches like back propagation and regression techniques to achieve the same purpose, this paper uses a custom designed Radial Basis Network due to its proven history of computational inexpensiveness and high accuracy and validates its accuracy through the results shown. Circuit design and yield optimizations using a method of moments(MoM) based electromagnetic simulation software was also done to verify accuracy and to feed the ground truth to the network. This neural network was implemented in python due to its vast resource library and ease of implementation.

Author Keywords: Method of moments based EM Simulation software

articleTitle: GLDraw: A Platform for Graph Visualization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Graph visualization refers to the representation of a graph, available as data, in an understandable human manner, such as a diagram of an abstract graph. These diagrams aimed at providing better readability to the user. Finding the best drawing strategy for a visually pleasing diagram is really challenging as it depends upon the quality and allowed time expected in the output. Almost all the existing graph drawing algorithms have a linear time-variant, but their practical implementation time differs widely. Existing platforms provide only a small number of algorithmic choices, so there is a difficulty in comparing all the algorithms for a particular task. In this paper, we describe GLDraw, our graph visualization tool. GLDraw (Graph Layout Drawing) provides the user, a choice of different graph drawing layouts and heuristics to improve the quality of the drawing. We have used GLDraw to find out the best strategy to draw planar graphs and perform a comparative study based on the time taken to produce the output for different graph drawing algorithms (or layouts). GLDraw also supports simultaneous drawing of shared graphs as well as multiple drawings of different graphs. The drawing techniques provided are hierarchical, orthogonal, grid, and force-directed methods. We have found that for different types of graphs, choosing an appropriate layout plays a vital role in achieving a quality drawing, for example, in case of tree graphs planarization grid and for general planar graphs force-directed would be the better option.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Power Management Framework for Electrical Vehicles in Smart City Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles are the future of mobility, which are dependent on battery technology, and as estimated, 70% of the two-wheeler and 50% of the EV's, price is estimated to be of batteries. In this dissertation work, power management framework model has been designed and developed for electric vehicles in smart city grid and the proof of concept has been disclosed. After an intense literature review, to design the framework for power management in EV's, three layered architecture is selected and the layers are divided as organisation layer, business logic layer, and analysis layer. The organisation is front layer for various electric vehicles sellers, developers and will act as a connecting layer for the user end and the proposed framework. The organisation layer is divided into three subfunctions namely: data segregation, data evaluation function, and data marshalling function. Where, data segregation is done w.r.t., core, luxury, and safety parameters function. Second layer has been divide into four sub-functions namely: data acquisition function, data un-marshalling function, data representation function, and data marshalling function. Third layer has been divided into four sub-functions namely: data acquisition function, data un-marshalling function, data segregation with respect to core, luxury, and safety parameters function and data analysis function. The proof of concept is given using the NetBeans software and framework designed has three layers which will be represented as three different server stations and the results obtain gives a very clear acceptance confirmation of the designed framework.

articleTitle: Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation (TENS) based Assistive Device for Surgeons
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Medical surgeons and medical training professionals are professionals who not only require high precision during surgeries but also need better control in surgery. In case of any accident or injury, their hand strength might lose precision. This precision can be acquired back with equipment that stimulates the muscles and locks the muscles. This process of muscle stimulation can result in making hands rigid. Assistive equipment is a great implementation of how bionics can be replaced with rather assistive technology which is modular and comprehensive. This system not only allows to stimulate the muscles but also allows to constrain the given situation of muscles by locking the muscles in place. Mounted IMU can help in capturing the data from the surgeon and then the system processes the information and parses it into the feedback conducting pads.

articleTitle: Design & FPGA Implementation of Gate Repositioning Technique for Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a design of Gate re-positioning technique for tracking of targets is presented which has been successfully implemented on an embedded platform. As the entire design is configured around FPGA, various new features can be added onto this design without doing any change in the core design. The development methodology and experimental results are also discussed.

articleTitle: Design Consideration of Wide Bandwidth Active Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In Remote-sensing and high resolution image application, the use of the synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has increased manifold. To achieve high resolution in range, the instantaneous bandwidth requirement is very large (>20 % for 10 GHz). The active electronically scanned array (AESA) antenna, which utilizes the narrow band width phase shifter, suffers from “beam-squint” phenomenon i.e. beam direction of the array changes across the instantaneous bandwidth. For applications with large bandwidth and high frequency requirements, true time delay beam-forming is a promising candidate. The true time delay units are expensive and bulky. This paper presents the tradeoffs in considering the distribution of true time delay units of phased array with reference to its performance of side lobe level, gain etc.

articleTitle: Geometrical Modelling of Over Burden (OB) Dump in Coal Mines for Microwave Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, the modelling and simulation of radar illumination on Over Burden (O.B) dumps in coal mines are analysed. Microwave sensor which is radiating the signal on the surface of O.B dump benches has to receive maximum backscattering, for which suitable angle and position of sensor placement need to be identified. The geometrical calculations are done using SOLIDWORK software. Geometrical simulation is done for sensor installation at different height and angle, to identify local incident angle on O.B dump benches, which is essential for radar backscattering. In simulation, sensor installation angle is changed from 5deg to - 15deg. Whereas provisions in hardware were made to have - 20deg to +20deg look angle. The aim of modelling is to identify suitable height and sensor look angle to ensure that all O.B dump benches illuminated and local incident angle <; 45deg. The maximum height of O.B dump in coal mines will be 150m, which are made in benches (typically 4 to 6 benches). The sensor elevation angle is limited to 10deg (antenna half power beam width) which will be installed a 1 Km away from benches for illuminating. The typical dimensions of these benches are taken to be 35m*30m of height*width. O.B dump reference position is taken at a distance of 1km from the proposed radar sensor for simulation.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction with Lasso Regression using Technical Analysis and Time Lag
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Stock price prophecy is one of the most recent topics of exploration in both university and business. Stock market is based on psychology of traders and it's uncertain but this uncertainty can be dodged based upon technical analysis. Though real live trading data have a few features but based upon the calculations of these less features more features are created that makes prediction an organized task. In this paper Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) Regression along with added features based on Technical Analysis such as Moving Averages, Relative Strength Index, Super Trend and Time Lag calculations, a proposed novel method to predict stock prices. The model is able to perform very well in terms of prediction on features that are added considering further days prices as targets. National Stock Exchange (NSE) NIFTY 50 index stock data is taken for empirical calculations.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Speed Control for Brushless DC motor driven vehicle using Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Conventional brushless DC (BLDC) speed controllers are affected by the uncertainties in plant and disturbances. In this work, a disturbance observer-based robust speed controller is proposed for BLDC motor driven three-wheeled lightweight chainless vehicle. All the uncertainties and disturbances present in the model are estimated using linear observer and their effect is nullified to get the robust closed-loop performance. Finally, stability of the proposed controller is proved on the lines of ultimate boundedness using a Lyapunov theory.

articleTitle: Digital Controller for Active Clamp based Synchronous Forward Converter for High Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Digital technology playing vital role in power electronic industry by providing novel method to control the DC-DC converter. In this project closed loop control of the converter is built by using reprogrammable FPGA A3P250- VQ100. This FPGA is programmed to develop the four MOSFET gate pulses with required delay, to drive the Main MOSFET, Active clamp MOSFET circuit and secondary side synchronous MOSFETs. Active clamp reset technique is used to reset the Transformer core, which helps to operate the converter for wide input voltage range and to reduce the Voltage spikes across the Main MOSFET. This circuit allow the main MOSFET to turn on at zero voltage, which reduces its switching loss and helps in improving the overall efficiency of the converter. Due to the low forward voltage drop, the MOSFETs are used as rectifier in the secondary side of Forward topology. Isolated Magnetic Feedback generator is used to sense the output voltage. The 12 bit ADC is used to convert the feedback voltage from Analog to Digital. In this paper, concentrating on designing 150W DC-DC converter by using the Digital control technique. The realization of Digital PID algorithm and over current, input raw under voltage and over voltage protection is discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of AC-DC Power Factor Correction Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The present work provides details of controller design for AC-DC power factor correction converter. Voltage mode and current mode control techniques of PFC converter has been discussed. Simulation as well as experimental verification has been provided to justify the theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Predicting Diabetes Mellitus Using Machine Learning and Optical Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus is recognized as a chronic metabolic disease that is characterized by hyperglycemia. As stated by the International Diabetes Federation, the statistics reveal that the incidence of diabetes among adults in Sri Lanka is 8.5%. In hindsight, this indicates that an average of one in every twelve adults in Sri Lanka is at risk of being diagnosed with the disease. However, presently, due to the lack of knowledge or mediums concerning the disease and its symptoms, diabetes often goes undetected which has resulted in 1/3 rd of the constituent population being unaware that they possess the disease. The proposed system aims to implement an application to read and analyze medical reports which will generate data that predicts the probabilities of the contraction and onset of diabetes, with insurance of maximum system efficiency and data credibility. Machine learning classification algorithms and optimization techniques have been used to predict diabetes status with maximum accuracy. To extract data from medical reports Optical Character Recognition, Image Processing, and Natural Language Processing have been used.

articleTitle: Hard Real-Time Delay (RTD) Estimation and Analysis for Safety-Critical System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Avionics embedded systems encapsulate the greater number of processing units that are completely under its control and with respect to the functional requirement very often they have strict timing analysis. The purpose of this work is to capture the timing analysis of the system-level data transfer using the AFDX format sending to the Multi-functional display computer, which has an IMA architecture. In the most recent years due to the strong partition of integrated modular avionics (IMA) architecture, they have been widely adopted in the field of avionics. In the development of avionics systems, although the architecture of IMA can achieve an effective reduction in cost and enhancement in reliability it results in less scheduling difficulty. So, even under the worst-case situations the deadlines of the IMA system should be meet and evaluation of the latency period has to obtain. The methodology involved for timing analysis is presented based on the case study carried out using visualsim simulation platform.

articleTitle: Detection of Lithium in Real World using Optical Emission Spectroscopy: Caution to E-Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The exponential increase in the use of digital technology in day-to-day life has generated an excessive aggregation of electronic waste (e-waste), which is one of the major sources of environmental contamination in the twenty-first century. Amongst them, lithium (Li) is the most pronounced one due to the extensive use of Li-ion batteries in nearly every electronic device. Disposal of lithium-ion batteries in soil and water leads to various adverse effects not only on human health but also on plants and aquatic creatures. Toxic effects on cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and endocrine systems are a few to mention. Therefore, the determination and quantification of the lithium level in the soil and water are extremely crucial. Here, we have developed a device and technique that can instantly quantify the lithium concentration in water and soil samples, at the site of sampling. The device is based on the principles of optical emission spectroscopy. To obtain the optical signals and to compute the electrolyte concentration a user-friendly software is developed. As proof of concept, we measured time-dependent Li-ion leaching in water and soil using the developed device and obtained promising results. The device is also IoT enabled for easy transfer of data from a remote place. Compared to the conventional techniques, our device is cost-effective, easily portable, requires less expertise and sample preparation, and also requires less time. As per our understanding, the current work will be pertinent in combating the adverse effects of e-waste in the environment using a non-invasive approach.

articleTitle: Visual Vibration Analysis of Vibrating Object at Low Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper explains the use of camera in recording and analyzing the vibration of visible objects. Through spatial and temporal analysis we analyze the elusive changes in the video recorded of object vibrating at low frequency. The information can be used in predicting the physical properties of the object and the force that is responsible for their motion. This paper uses the input video of the simple harmonic pendulum which is vibrating at low frequency. The algorithm developed is used for processing the video and extracting the motion of the pendulum bob using visual vibration analysis. By using cameras for analyzing the vibrations of the object we can present cameras as an low cost vibration sensor with intensely high spatial resolution than the devices that are used from past for vibration measurement. By doing this we give a world a new way to use camera as a powerful tool for vibration analysis.

articleTitle: Is There Any Further Scope for Improving the Efficiency of Modern Websites?
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Interface is an intermediate medium of interaction between human and computer for effective communication. In recent years, with the advancement of WWW, efficient user interface design has become evident for better user-experiences. Efficiency is used as a key component for determining the key metric of a website-Usability. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficiency of different websites, popularly used in our life. In order to carry out this task, ten websites were considered. For each website, a representative task was selected. Ten participants were used to complete this task in the Latin Square method. Experimental results show that most of the interfaces are efficient. However, there is a further scope for improving efficiency of those websites.

articleTitle: Low RCS Antenna Loaded with Stepped Impedance Resonator and Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a new approach to design an antenna for low radar cross section (RCS) application using microstrip technology is developed. For this purpose, a rectangular patch antenna with rotated C-shaped slot for impedance matching, circular shaped slot in the center of the patch along with Complementary Split Ring Resonator (CSRR) is designed. To achieve a better reduction in the RCS at the desired central frequency, the radiating edges of the antenna are loaded with stepped impedance resonator, as levelled edges of the radiating surfaces contribute to an increased RCS. The antenna radiates at 2.3GHz, has an impedance bandwidth of 44.2MHz and a gain of 4.47dBi. The monostatic RCS is -24.77dBsm at the radiating frequency. Results show that loading the radiating edges with stepped impedance resonator and the addition of the planar metamaterials aid in the reduction of the RCS of the antenna.

articleTitle: Analytical Model of β-Ga2O3 MESFET for Transconductance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Transconductance of β-Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> MESFET is graphically calculated by analyzing characteristics curve of the designed MESFET for different channel height, electron concentration, gate to source voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</sub>) and drain to source voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</sub>). With decreasing channel height and electron concentration the value of the transconductance also decreased. The transconductance also decreased with the increasing value of negative gate to source voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</sub>). The designed device is subjected to higher negative value of gate to source voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</sub>) and acted satisfactorily as the β-Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> has higher band gap and other advantages. By observing the computed transconductances it is seen that the designed MESFET exhibits high transconductance value and ensures high electron mobility of the device as well. The results that are found are suitable and the designed MESFET can be surely used as an amplifier and other switching ICs in various nano electronic circuits.

articleTitle: Grid-Interactive Hybrid (PV-SOFC) Power System with Controlled Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The planned system is a PV-SOFC based renewable power generating system. The system is synchronized with the grid parameters to enhance the system efficiency, to make the system more cost-effective and inclusion of renewable sources over the conventional used generating sources. The controlling technique used in the proposed system is a basic PLL technique that takes into account the grid active, reactive power and the frequency as the reference and compares them within the hysteresis band till the error signal is zero.

articleTitle: Hybrid Algorithm on Semantic Web Crawler for Search Engine to Improve Memory Space and Time
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: World Wide Web is a colossal reservoir of hyperlink documents, these hyperlinks documents lay the foundation for communication on this omnipresent computing world. An acute need has arisen to develop and modify or design search algorithms that helps in efficiently and competently searching the specific required data from the huge repository available. A variety of search engines employ diverse web crawlers for obtaining search results efficiently. A variety of search engines use diverse web crawlers for obtaining search results proficiently. Some search engines use focused web crawler that collects different web pages that usually satisfy some specific property, by effectively prioritizing the crawler frontier and managing the exploration process for hyperlink. In this paper the main objective of this research is identifying the bottlenecks in the conventional framework. It conceives the experiment architecture which will showcase an improved technique to speed up the crawling process. This will lay the foundation for a future generation of current web. It will expand the horizon of crawling to diversify its application to the industry specific crawling mechanism. Shannon gain algorithm is used to determine the Threshold value of dynamic dataset. Experiments have been conducted on Apriori, Eclat, Declat Algorithms, Proposed hybrid algorithm. The comparative assessment of memory usage reflects the minimal consumption by the hybrid architecture. One of the main features of our proposed Method is its ability to tunnel through pages with a low score.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Micro Combustor along with Recirculation Cap over Stability of Flame
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The objective of this work is to study numerically the flame stabilization of a MEMS based methane-air micro -combustor (adiabatic). Three backward step micro-combustor with and without recirculation cap are simulated computationally through the usage of methane- air premixed fuel in the quartz micro combustor. A software ANSYS fluent has been used for simulating different designs (models). To make flame stable, the methane-air fuel (equivalence ratio→ 0.6) has been premixed. For various inlet velocities, 1, 3, 5 and 8 ms<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, of the premixed fuel have been analyzed in this model. It can be inferred from the results that by adding the recirculation cap over the surface of micro combustor the flame thickness (flame stretching) increases. Due to increase in the thickness of the flame the stability has been increased.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Development of DC Switch Mode Power Supply feeding Plasma Torch based Incinerator for Radioactive Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The radioactive solid wastes from various nuclear facilities are of variety of composition with radioactive contents. Each radioactive nuclide has its unique waste management methodology. The most suited DC plasma torch power sources have been utilized for the treatment at waste management facility for safe disposal of nuclear waste. The plasma torch being a very high temperature source destructs all sort of toxic compounds generated during incineration. The high temperature plasma torches are heat sources that exhibit unique functionality, higher power intensity and wide-ranging versatility. The article contains design study, circuit simulation, analysis and implementation of switch mode power supply feeding DC power to plasma torch based incinerator for radioactive waste management. Based on the configuration of the power supply schematics, the circuit is divided into modules and each module is designed individually. The modules comprises 18 pulse input rectifier, high frequency inverter, resonant converter and high frequency rectifier. The simulation results have been presented and compared with actual characteristics of the system, validating simulation performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Study Of Google Search Engine Optimization Algorithms: Panda, Penguin and Hummingbird
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Thousands of websites are hosted daily all over the world. However, very few of them actually make an impact on the world wide web and attract valuable web traffic. In this scenario, Search Engine Qptimization(SEO) has become a very significant factor to increase the ranking of such websites by improving the quality of content and thereby increasing visibility for relevant searches. There are various page ranking algorithms present today to help with this aspect of SEO and this paper is going to present a comparative analysis of some of the popular Google SEO algorithms such as Panda, Penguin and Hummingbird which help in detecting low quality websites thereby affecting their ranking on the search engine results page(SERP).

articleTitle: Micro-controller Based Portable Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper describes the development of a portable oscilloscope that has similar functionalities as that of a traditional oscilloscope. A portable PC based oscilloscope using ATmega 328 micro-controller is developed. This system could achieve the voltage and frequency ranges supported by those available in the standard college laboratories for routine lab experiments. This plays a crucial role in aiding academic activities, which can now be done remotely without needing specific lab facility.

articleTitle: Prediction of Students' GPA Using Levenberg–Marquardt Backpropagation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Courses marks are the main factors that contribute to the Grade Point Average, commonly called GPA. Besides, GPA describes the academic success of the student. Predicting the students' GPA becomes essential for the student in preparing for their studies in the next semester. However, the prediction itself needs to be reviewed by students to get the proper weighted value. The purpose of this research is to predict the students' GPA as an information exchange study using the Levenberg-Marquardt Backpropagation algorithm. This study applies to the Higher Secondary Certificate Students' GPA. The required dataset is downloaded from the Kaggle website. The results show that the best architecture for solving the problem is a 9-12-1 pattern. It implies that there are nine units in the input layer, 12 neurons in the hidden layer, and one unit in the output layer which results are in a high predictive level.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CNTFET based 6T SRAM Cell with Tube and Chiral Variation under 16 and 32 nm Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper deals with the performance analysis of Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistor (CNTFET) based 6TSRAM under different technologies. The efficiency of this circuit is observed by changing the number of tubes and the chiral vector of the device. Parameters like Average Power Consumption, Average Power Delay Product (PDP) and Average Delay were taken to consideration for observing the efficiency of the CNTFET based 6T SRAM. The results obtained show that the Average Power Consumption increases to almost 3 times when the value of chiral vector reaches maximum and 5 times for the maximum number of tubes in this observation. In case of average delay, the value becomes almost half when the chiral vector reaches maximum but there is a negligible change due to change in number of tubes. A similar change can be observed even when the channel length is varied.

articleTitle: Ranking the Feedstocks Using Neural Network-Based System for Biofuel Production
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The progressive movement from fossil to renewable fuels like biofuels is one of this century's challenges. Identifying the right feedstock is the biggest challenge in generating high-quality, sustainable second-generation biofuels. The solution to these problems can be found in second-generation agro-industrial biofuels, as their use does not compete with food resources; it also allows low-commercial raw material processing and provides an alternative to the disposal of such raw material. This study explores an innovative approach to classifying feedstocks, using secondary literature data sources. Besides the high reliability of methods used, the study analysed researching over 20 parameters of 106 feedstocks. The research developed a rating system for Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA), including weighting for each parameter based on expert opinion or statistical methods such as PCA. The ranking system output then be fed into a Multivariate Regression (MVR) and a Multilayer perceptron (MLP), to rank feedstock to produce the highest quality sustainable biofuels for a particular location. The above rating will first be based on particular location agroclimatic characteristics, including Rockhampton (e.g., rainfall, temperature, light intensity, etc.). The algorithm can then be used at other locations (e.g., Brisbane, Cairns and Townsville) to override the agroclimatic parameter. After comparing performance of MVR to MLP, the study suggests that MLP output produces statistically significant results referring to rank the feedstocks. ANN model implemented in Python proved adequate to classify the feedstock successfully. It achieved a high validation accuracy calculated by the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> metric at 0.68. This result suggests that adding more data gives added significance to the results. Outputs would support prospective buyers and also be a thorough feedstock analysis.

Author Keywords: Deep Neural Network and Ranking Model

articleTitle: An Automation Methodology for Amelioration of SpyGlassCDC Abstract View Generation Process
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The integration of numerous IPs with increasing RTL complexity over the system on chip (SoC) has become a difficult task. In the SoC, multiple IPs are working on different clocks, graving challenges like metastability, data loss etc. may arise in the regime of asynchronous clocks. These issues must be tackled carefully early in the design-cycle as it impacts the technical feasibility of the SoC. An unresolved clock domain crossing (CDC) issue can result in design failure forcing an expensive design re-spin, this extends time to market by months, greatly reducing chips market share and profit potential. SpyGlassCDC is one such tool that provides a rich suit of rule set to verify different kinds of CDC issues. The hierarchical verification flow of SpyGlassCDC allows us to use the abstract views for block level that can be used to perform SoC level CDC verification. However, there is a gap between state-of-art techniques and the requirements of modern designs, as the methodology involves repetitive human efforts and is susceptible to manual errors that make it difficult to meet the stringent timeline. Therefore, this paper presents an automation methodology for the generation of abstract views. The proposed methodology has eliminated the repetitive human efforts and manual errors involved in the existing methods. Results show that the proposed methodology reduced the SpyGlassCDC validation time by significant amount (about 84%). Also features like selective regression, log file generation makes it more efficient than existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Bird.s Eye: Analysis of Video Surveillance Data using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Video surveillance data is widely used as a measure for security in various places like residential areas, shopping malls and so on. This video data is recorded 24x7 and therefore the task to find a particular object or event becomes tedious. Precious manual hours are wasted by security officials trying to skim through the video data trying to find the object they are searching for. This paper aims to reduce the manual effort required in this process by automating and focusing on the object the user is searching for. We have implemented multi-class object detection using YOLO algorithm and deep neural networks. The application will detect commonplace objects, classify them accordingly and extract the features of these objects. The user will be able to query the video data using the name of the object and the features. The paper is expected to detect objects of interest and extract basic features with reasonable accuracy and processing times through which it can be deployed in real-world surveillance applications.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Model and Power Control in Macrocell-Femtocell Networks by Lion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the macro-femto HetNets, FBSs and its deployment are done by users unknowning to Macroocell BS, thus, the intercell interference defines the power allocation, subcarrier assignment or allocation and price allocation as well. This paper scrutinize crosstier interference mitigation in FDOFDMA based HetNets consisting of macrocell-femtocells. In this paper three major contributions will be subjected: defining a single objective problem that includes three constraints like power allocation, subcarrier allocation and price allocation of Macro-Femto Networks, as the work concentrates on the optimization logics using Lion algorithm which based on lions social behavior like territorial defence & territorial takeover. The solution encoding process seems to be the most important aspect which introduce a new encoding transformation model of all the three allocation strategies, introducing Lion Algorithm LA algorithm are required to solve the above mentioned optimization problem in Macrocell-Femtocell Networks. The performance of algorithm is the trade of maintainability state-of-the-arts models concerning convergence and statistical analysis of LA Algorithm.

articleTitle: SLAM using AD* Algorithm with Absolute Odometry
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The use of mobile robots is continuously increasing in Industrial applications such as assembly line automation, warehouse robots, inspection in power lines in smart grids etc. Localization and mapping are the key technologies of mobile robots and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is considered as an essential basis for this. SLAM is usually resource intensive and also requires high fidelity sensors in order to navigate an environment effectively. Hector SLAM continuously uses all nearby obstacles and objects in order to determine the location of the robot. This is resource intensive as the agent keeps a track of all the objects in its proximity. To cope with this problem, this paper proposes Anytime D* algorithm along with absolute odometry we eliminate the factor of continuously monitoring the environment W.R.T to the robot/agent. The localization of the agent is done by using reverse kinematics. This allows for the use of low fidelity sensors such as Infrared sensors as well as Ultrasonic sensors. This algorithm creates an occupancy grid in real time as the agent moves through the environment with a goal to goal controller.

articleTitle: Optimal Utilization of Hardware for the Real Valued FFT Architectures
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Real-valued Serial Commutator (RSC) FFT achieves 100 percent utilization of hardware using the irreversible logic gates for the adder/subtractor operation in the butterfly structure. These irreversible logic gates are inept in low power VLSI design. In this paper the proposed system uses the reversible logic gates for the operation. This yields in reduction of power consumption and chip area. The proposed system consumes 20 percent less power and requires 17 percent less area than the existing system.

articleTitle: State and Disturbance Observer based Sliding Mode Control for Nonlinear Uncertain Mismatched Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The control design for general nonlinear uncertain mismatched systems is challenging when all the states are not available and the available states are affected by measurement noise. In this paper, a novel state and disturbance observer based sliding mode control design for nonlinear uncertain mismatched system is proposed. The proposed control strategy does not require the measurement of all the states of the mismatched system and at the same time it ensures that the tracking accuracy is better than the conventional results as well as latest result in [1]. The proposed method makes the approaches in [1], [12] implementable for the applications where all the states are available for the control design. The paper further analyses the effect of measurement noise on the output tracking accuracy. The comparative study is carried out to prove the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode and Inertial Delay Based Direct Yaw Moment Control for AGVs
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The direct yaw moment control (DYC) obtained using active front-wheel steering and differential forces at each wheel is an effective technique in achieving vehicle stability. In this paper, a sliding mode and inertial delay control (IDC) is designed to achieve DYC. In this method, the uncertainties in vehicle parameters and external disturbances are estimated using IDC and used in the sliding mode control (SMC) framework to force the vehicle to track the desired yaw rate and sideslip angle. The proposed controller is free from chatter and does not need the uncertainties' bound. The stability of the controller is established using the Lyapunov theory. The potency of the prospective controller has been proved by executing the simulation for varying driving conditions.

articleTitle: A Tool to Design DC Inductor Using Core Geometry Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A DC Inductor is a crucial element in many power electronic circuits. The conventional procedure to design a DC Inductor is iterative hence difficult and time-consuming. Also, the design requires the background knowledge of Magnetics, Material Science, Heat Transfer, and Fundamental of physics. This paper proposes a new mathematical tool that eliminates the need for expertise in these subjects. The tool based on Core Geometry coefficient is devised in a pervasive software like Microsoft Excel to design DC inductors and analyze their performance. It simplifies the time-consuming calculations, which enhances the efficiency and optimizes the realization of the DC inductor. It also provides a better understanding of the DC inductor's operations and performance trade-offs, which accelerates the design of power converters.

articleTitle: Outage Probability in Large-Scale Antenna System for Cooperative Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a relay-assisted cooperative network having a large number of antenna across relay station (RS), which assist source and destination node. In the first part of this work, a closed-form expression for the PDF of end-to-end (E2E) SNR has been derived. With the help of derived PDF, a nearly closed-form expression for outage probability has also been derived, which is a function of multiple parameters like minimum E2E SNR, number of RS antenna and many more. During outage formulation, all integration is not fully integrable. Hence numerical integration technique has been used for solving a complex integral. Keeping other constraints remain fixed, the impact of a number of antenna across RS and destination node over outage probability has been numerically verified.

articleTitle: Detection of Hydration Status by the Ratio of Extracellular Fluid to Total Body Water in Noninvasive Way
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, hydration status of a human body has been measured by non-invasive way using the ratio of Extra-Cellular Fluid (ECF) to Total Body Water (TBW). New mathematical models of extracellular fluid and total body water have been developed based on bioelectrical impedance analysis. Total 3000 (number of male data is 1500 and number of female data is 1500) data have been adopted for the research purpose. Proposed models have been compared with existing models by different types of statistical tools like correlation coefficient, limit of agreement, bias and root mean square error. The measured hydration status of the people using the ratio of ECF to TBW has been compared with the actual hydration status and the overall accuracies are found as 96.67% for male and 97.69<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> for female. This proposed method of hydration status prediction will be helpful for the quick detection of different types of disease related to body fluid.

articleTitle: Cost modelling study on the feasibility of on-orbit refuelling of Indian Geo-satellite fleet
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for geostationary satellites services, all efforts are being made to minimize the cost of the entire geo-satellite system. On-orbit refuelling of geo-satellites is one of the ways to achieve this. In this regard a geo-refuelling system utilising multiple refueller satellites for on-orbit refuelling using current capabilities of satellites and launchers of ISRO is configured. For this initially an economic feasibility study was carried out based on unit telecommunication cost of refuelled and conventional geo satellites. The study was able to identify the main parameters of a regularly refuelled geo-satellite fleet which dictate its economic feasibility. For a geo-satellite fleet with refuelling, various fleet combinations are possible with the four different categories of satellites viz, Ilk, I2k, I3k, I4k and with multiple refuellers. All such possible combinations of refuellers and refuelled satellites are explored and combinations which provide desirable profitability are narrowed down for further selection. Two notional mission scenarios are identified and suitable satellite categories and combinations for each scenario is identified which provide economic viability.

articleTitle: Surface Tolerance Analysis of offset Reflector Antenna in Ku-Band
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper describes the surface tolerance analysis of 3m offset reflector antenna. The radiation pattern performance degradation (gain loss) due to surface tolerance/roughness is analyzed at Ku-band (high frequency or short wavelength). Compared the gain loss variation with respect to rms surface error by using the Ruze's equation and CAD simulation. Ruze's equation states that the antenna gain is inversely proportional to the square of the RMS surface error. The gain loss is increase drastically over rms surface error of 1mm. Analyzed the gain loss over the range of RMS surface error varying from 0.5mm to 5mm. The objective of the paper is to the analyses the effect on radiation pattern (Gain Loss, Side Lobe Label (SLL), Cross-polarization) due to the surface roughness/tolerance of 3m offset reflector at Ku-band and define the fabrication tolerance within the acceptable RMS surface error for manufacturing. Surface roughness error has been analyzed as considering two realistic approaches: RMS error variation analysis on 3m offset reflector and RMS error variation analysis on the three different zones (section) spaced at 1m of 3m offset reflector parabolic antenna.

articleTitle: State and Disturbance Estimation Based Sliding Mode Control for Antilock Braking Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This article proposes a slip control method for antilock braking systems (ABSs) with an unmeasurable state and mismatched uncertainty. In this method, both state and disturbances are estimated and used in sliding mode control to force the slip to track the desired value. The model considered is a two-axle vehicle with load transfer effects and actuator dynamics. The proposed method does not require sensors for measurements of the tire-road friction coefficient and brake torques. The control is free from the chatter and robust to external disturbances. The controller's stability is proved, and its performance is assessed analytically. Extensive simulation is performed using MATLAB/Simulink considering different road conditions to verify the analysis.

articleTitle: Endorsement just a hashtag +1 away
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: One of the major reasons of delayed development project deliveries is the time taken to resolve critical or nontrivial issues. Time also gets consumed in developing the Proof of Concept before final development where the area is niche, and the procedure is not known. Critical system setups also consume time. Imagine, a platform that can easily tell you if the issue you are facing has already been faced and resolved, a concept you are building using new approach has already been achieved by someone. Some tapping into the potentials of this platform can reduce project impediments and speed up the development. This paper explains in detail that a huge percentage of people who solve critical issues skip writing blogs or articles on open forums as it requires time for content writing and due to which these experts are not visible to the world for help. This forum allows the users to quickly share their knowledge without writing lengthy blogs and get recognized as experts for helping others in resolving critical issues. It also let other users to search for experts and save time for further development. We have named this forum as Endorsement - just a #tag +1 away! because via this forum getting endorsed on a skillset requires only creating a hashtag and getting an upvote on providing the right solution to the query asked.

articleTitle: MOSFET-based Three-Phase Inverter using Arduino - Applicable in Microgrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: To address the requirement for three-phase inverters in microgrid systems or sustainable-powered industrial facilities, a MOSFET-based three-phase inverter is designed and implemented, which can convert DC power into three-phase AC. The designed system produces 223V square (AC) waves at each phase from a 12V battery (DC) through switching of three stages of power MOSFETs using PWM signals at their gates from an Arduino Uno R3. Each stage of MOSFETs consists of six MOSFETs making it eighteen in total, which are used to perform the inversion process separately for each of three single-phase connections. The system is programmed through the Arduino Uno to generate the PWM signals and to keep 120 degrees phase displacement among each phase. Three center-tapped step-up transformers are used at the outputs of MOSFET stages for signal amplification. Using a 60W incandescent light bulb at each phase as a load, the system produces 386.25 V of voltage for three-phase line, delivering 0.58A of current. The design and simulation of the electronic circuit are done by Proteus 8.9 Professional, and the programming codes are written using Arduino IDE. The designed system is practically contrasted and tested.

articleTitle: Energy and Power Analysis of Novel Nano Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As predicted by Moore in his law that the transistor density doubles every 24 months but this law seems to be in violation today. Now, new methods of digital logic implementation are in the testing process. One of the latest developments in this field is the implementation of digital logic through Quantum Dots which is an application of Quantum tunnelling phenomenon in the Quantum world. This new technology has many advantages over the traditional method of CMOS logic implementation. Also, many designs of common logical circuits are being proposed daily, but the difference lies in whether these designs are efficient or not. Efficiency is dependent on cell count, cell area, latency, crossovers, complexity, and most importantly energy and power dissipation parameters. A circuit that uses less energy and dissipates less power is considered to be good. In this paper, we have analyzed a parity generator and a parity detector for its energy and power parametric. Also, a comparison is shown between previously designed Parity generators and detectors and the proposed one. After the comparative analysis, it was found that the proposed design was 35% efficient in terms of Energy and Power Dissipation factors.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Returns from Cryptocurrencies at Varying Frequencies: Failure of Cubic Law
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Statistical analysis of returns for four popular cryptocurrencies viz. Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple and Litecoin is carried out at varying frequencies. It is found that q-Gaussian distribution fits well to empirical distribution of normalized returns for all the four cryptocurrencies at daily, hourly and minute level. A new method based on Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic is proposed to estimate the distribution parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$q$</tex>. The analysis also reveals that normalized returns from cryptocurrencies depict power law with scaling parameter of 2.66, thus violating the cubic law of returns observed in traditional financial markets. The conformation of q-Gaussian distribution across various distinct cryptocurrencies indicate that underlying dynamics of them is identical and they belong to same universality class. These results will help in making better investment decisions and trading strategies.

articleTitle: Process Stabilization based on LQR Optimal Controller and Pole Placement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In recent trend stabilization of the system is a very basic classical control problem in the field of the control system. Moreover, the techniques don't just stabilize the system, but improve the system response is having its significant impact. In this paper, a nonlinear system like an inverted pendulum has been utilized. The dynamics of an inverted pendulum on the cart are analogous to various real word applications like robot arm, missile launching system, balancing systems. The purpose of the control mechanism is to balance the pendulum. It has been done with optimally controlled Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR). Stability analysis has been done with the classical pole placement method and the result has been compared with Linear Quadratic Regulator.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Variable Optical Attenuator on Different Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper Ridge, S-bend waveguide design and analysis has been performed for C-band using various materials like Silica (SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), Silicon Nitride (Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>), Barium Fluoride (BaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) and Titanium Dioxide (TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>). We have performed a comparative study and identified Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as the most suitable material for silicon photonics platform based on lower insertion and propagation losses. Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> based ridge waveguide reduces insertion loss to 5.68dB and propagation loss to less than 1dB/cm. These designed waveguides will be used in variable optical attenuator. Here in this paper, we also propose a variable optical attenuator based on the configurations of a Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> -BaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> S-bend waveguides. The thermo-optic characteristics of Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and BaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> materials are fully utilized for making variable optical attenuator (VOA). After performing software simulation, simulation results are verified with theoretical results. We get Optical attenuation of 1 to 50 dB with an applied electrical voltage of 0 to 20 V for length of 100 um device with low insertion loss.

articleTitle: No Reference Image Quality Assessment for JPEG Images using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Popular and widely used JPEG images suffer from blocking artifact. Blocking artifact degrades the quality of an image. No Reference Image Quality Assessment (NRIQA) metric using block based features are designed in this paper. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Neuro Fuzzy Classifier (NFC) are employed to evaluate the performance of the proposed metric. It is tested for LIVE, TID2008 and TID2013 datasets. Results show improvement in accuracy independent of image databases. The proposed metric is compared with state-of-the-art metrics for LIVE dataset.

articleTitle: Identification of QRS Segments of Electrocardiogram signals using Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: For the intensive need of arrhythmia identification of patients it is necessary to explore the feature segments of electrical representation of heart signals i.e. ECG signals. A feature extraction algorithm is presented in this paper for QRS segment detection, which is based upon the amplitude and derivative characteristics of QRS complex segment. The performance of proposed algorithm is evaluated on the parameters of sensitivity (Se %) and positive predictivity (+P %) and compared with Pan Tompkins and GR algorithm for clinical database. Sensitivity (Se %) of proposed algorithm is calculated as 99.71% which is 0.46 % higher than Pan Tompkins and 0.02% higher than GR algorithm. The overall positive predictivity (+P %) of proposed algorithm is 99.69% which is 0.58% higher than Pan Tompkins and 0.2% higher than GR algorithm. The proposed algorithm performs superior as a result from parametric improvements for the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database.

articleTitle: CT Based Histogram Assisted Emphysema Severity Quantification
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Emphysema is defined as loss of lung tissue and considered one of the main reasons for causing COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease). Thus a proper differentiation between emphysematous and healthy lung tissues is a big necessity. This paper aims to discuss a novel approach to assess the emphysema severity through chest CT image analysis. From the histogram of the segmented lung region of a chest CT image a single intensity threshold in Hounsfield Units (HU) is taken into account to determine the relative no. of pixels with low attenuation values below it. This parameter has been widely used to measure the severity of emphysema from CT images. The study considers RA-910 HU, the pixel index or emphysema index as the intensity threshold to measure the proportion of pixels with densities or attenuation values or HU lesser than it, which usually refer to regions contributing emphysema. CT images of 5 subjects (both COPD and non-COPD smokers and non-smokers) were processed and used for quantitative analysis in this study to get a fundamental hold of the degree of severity of emphysema.

articleTitle: Application of Extended Hough Transform Technique for Stationary Images in Vehicle License Plate
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Automatic Vehicle License Plate Recognition has been gained popularity in recent years as it leads to antisocial activities such as car theft, car over speeding, breaking the traffic rules and many other activities. In this paper, Extended Hough Transform algorithm have been proposed while applying for extracting License Plates. Simulation results have been shown and it has been demonstrated that this algorithm performs much better when it is being compared to Standard Hough Transform.

articleTitle: Monocular camera-based go-to-goal control of holonomic robots
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Visual servoing in autonomous mobile robots has received significant interest in recent times as navigation of the robots can be performed without the use of external sensors, such as GPS or beacons. A commonly performed task by such robots is to move to target locations in their working environment. By fixing these locations with unique well-known visual markers, such as a “plus” symbol in a helipad, using on-board cameras to identify these visual markers, and on-board hardware to process the images, the robots can be made to navigate to them. In this paper, we propose a simple and efficient vision-based “go-to-goal” (GtG) algorithm for a holonomic mobile robot equipped with a single monocular camera. The goal is identified by a marker with known dimensions and is calibrated for the camera. With this information, the GtG algorithm enables the robot to move to this marker from any position in the environment. Simulation results, derived from experiments performed in the ROS environment, demonstrate its operation and features.

articleTitle: Query Optimization for Cloud Database
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper work is mainly focussing on query optimization of database on cloud computing environment. We are also taking care of implementation of such cloud databases on public as well as private cloud system. During the research of this topic, after going through various literatures available, we found that resource allocation on private cloud and public cloud is really a challenging one and also working on cloud databases for optimization on NoSQL Databases through various cluster will be a new concepts of implementation and we wish to see their real-time results based on various operation.

articleTitle: Automated Location Scouting and Production Planning for Movie Industry in Sri Lanka using scripts written in Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The film industry in Sri Lanka has grown into a multi-billion-dollar industry. However, it has not reached its fullest potential yet. This is due to the insufficient number of films produced locally. One of the major causes for a film to fail is the low attention given for production planning. Planning should take place with the commencement of the Preproduction state. This should include the entire process from scriptwriting to final ticket issuing. The pre-production state that determines the success or failure of the film consists of the critical processes that will be required to execute the production state. Place Scouting is one of the main processes in a production plan. Since the film industry focuses primarily on the esthetic enjoyment of people in society, scenic beauty is a must when choosing locations for a film. “Film-It” is developed to provide all-around assistance in Location Scouting and Resource Planning in the Pre-Production State of a movie. With the aid of this application, key players in the film industry will be able to save their time, effort and money spend on Preproduction preparation. Key stakeholders in the film industry have confirmed that this application would carry the Sri Lankan film industry to a whole new level.

articleTitle: Improved and Efficient Optical-NoC Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The optical-NoCs are becoming more and more dominating in the case of multicore architectures. In recent years we are moving fast from wire interconnects to optical interconnects as they are more reliable and providing more efficient results. In this work, we have introduced our new architecture to eliminate our previous work limitation. We have proposed new architecture to provide a better waveguide network between nodes. In addition to our previous work, we have also introduced a new routing algorithm that works on this architecture and provides deadlock-free routing among nodes. Furthermore, simulation results show that the proposed new methodology provides better results in terms of high reliability, less hop count, and up to 100% link utilization. These results are conducted on different architecture from 3X3 to 15X15 optical-NoC. It follows that the proposed methodology provides significant results as well as removes the limitation of our previous work.
